page_counting_rule: Physical PDF page numbers (1-based). Counted: body pages of the Overview and Chapters 1-9, from the chapter's first page up to the page before its 'Notes' bookmark. Excluded: cover, title, copyright, contents, foreword, acknowledgments, abbreviations, part divider pages, Notes and References pages, and Spotlight sections (short boxed essays with their own notes). Page ranges and part/chapter values are taken from the PDF's own bookmarks (outline). Pages inside the ranges whose text cannot be extracted are logged in starter/results/ingest_log.json and not counted.
